context: Tests whether plugin-creator implements a live capability as a bundled MCP server rather than prose. The plugin must contain a root .mcp.json using the supported HTTP shape, an explicit fixed manifest pointer, no credentials, and no hand-authored consuming-agent configuration.

checklist.name: Root MCP file created
checklist.description: component-search/.mcp.json exists at the plugin root, not inside a skill or agent-specific config directory

checklist.name: Valid MCP envelope
checklist.description: .mcp.json contains a top-level `mcpServers` map with a named component-search server

checklist.name: Correct HTTP server config
checklist.description: The component-search server has `type: http` and the exact URL https://components.meridian.internal/mcp

checklist.name: Explicit manifest pointer
checklist.description: component-search/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json sets `mcpServers` to the fixed value `.mcp.json` or `./.mcp.json`

checklist.name: Capability not prose
checklist.description: The output implements the live capability with .mcp.json and does not substitute a skill or rule that merely tells the model how to call the service

checklist.name: No credentials invented
checklist.description: The MCP declaration contains no tokens, passwords, Authorization header, or invented authentication configuration

checklist.name: No direct agent config edits
checklist.description: The output does not create or edit consuming-agent MCP configuration such as .claude.json, .mcp.json outside the plugin, or .cursor/mcp.json

checklist.name: No unrelated primitives
checklist.description: The plugin does not add hooks, rules, commands, or unrelated skills for this single live-capability requirement

checklist.name: Valid plugin metadata
checklist.description: component-search/.tessl-plugin/plugin.json has the requested name plus valid version and description fields
